tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi nyams len ye shes gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swasti/ dpal ldan pad+ma rā ga'i ri yi dbang / /dus me'i phreng bas bskor 'dra'i sgyu 'phrul la/ /'di na dus dgra'i dbang por mtshan gsol ba/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med gang der 'dud/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i gter/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bye ba'i zhal gyi bcud/ /rgya bod grub dbang stong gis bgrod pa'i lam/ /gsang chen snying po'i nyams len 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'dir dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud don snying po rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa chen po'i zhal gyi gdams pas/ paṇa grub dbang po darban a tsār+yas gangs can gyi ljongs su spyan drangs shing / glo bo lo tsā ba chen po shes rab rin chen gyis rgya cher spel ba'i dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rdzogs rim mthar thug pa shin tu spros pa med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid legs par thob pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dag gis rgyun gyi nyams len du dril ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom par 'dod pas/ ji ltar 'os pa'i gnas su bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas pas/ sems kyi rnam rtog 'phro 'du dgos med rnams rgyun bcad/ nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas bslangs te/ skyabs yul rnams legs par gsal btab/ ngag tu brjod pa ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes tshar bdun la sogs pa brjod pa'i mthar/ lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi brgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pas skyabs yul rnams rang la bstim/

sems 'dzin med du ci gnas bzhag bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lam gyi rim pa zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa tshar gsum gyis sems bskyed de sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ngag tu hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla re ye shes kyi me 'bar ba srung 'khor yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i dbus su seng ge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma ma he dmar po dang gshin rje nag po'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid mtshan nas brjod de/ rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs bcom ldan 'das dpal gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon pas bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer dang bsus khyim dang brla dang brang zheng rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag dang nying lag rnams thung zhing rags pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ khrag 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang / skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gshin rje'i tshogs skrag par mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing /

g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bla ma dam pa de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan rang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas spyan drangs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de'i dbu'i steng gi thad tsam nas bzung ste/ g.yon gyi cha la rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rang rang gi rgyan cha lugs na bza' sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ bdag nyid la zhal phyogs pa'i rnam pa can/ 'od zer gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs par bsam/ de dag gi rgyab 'og gi phyogs su yi dam rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs/ de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku la byang sems nyan rang gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ de'i 'og tu dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma sogs las bzhi sgrub byed kyi lha'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ de thams cad kyang dges shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pas bdag nyid la zhal phyogs par bzhugs par gsal btab/ de dag las mchod pa dang gsol ba 'debs pa gnyis las/ dang po la yang thun mong gi mchod pa dang / phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyis mchod pa las/ dang po ni so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya mā ri maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swāhā/ pā t+yaṃ pra tits+tsha ye swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du dhūṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta ā hūm̐ zhes brjod/ phyi mchod ni/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ aḥrū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+dhe badz+ri hūm̐/

oṃ āḥr sa badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpar+sha badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma dha tu badz+ri hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ nang bdud rtsis mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes kyi mchod par bsam/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod tshul rnams rang sems spros med ngo shes par bya'o/ /gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs pad+ma spangs nas ni/ /bdag la gzhan na skyabs ma mchis/ /khyod kyis thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /deng 'dir bdag la bka' drin mdzod/ /zhes tshar gcig brjod/ de nas rang mgron rnams kyi mdun phyogs su gnas pa'i g.yas su bdud sdig can gyis gtso byas pa'i sdang dgra gnod bgegs thams cad gsal btab/ g.yon du pha mas gtso byas pa'i gnyen dang lha srung thams cad gsal btab/ rgyab tu bar ma'i 'gro ba thams cad bsam/ mdun du rang dbang ba'i yul 'khor longs spyod zas nor thams cad bsam/ rim bzhin 'bul bar bsams la yid gtad de/ bdag gi dgra dang bgegs thams cad dpal ldan bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod pas de thams cad bla mas thugs dgyes bzhin du bdag gir mdzad pas rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang thams cad dag phyin chad zhe sdang skye ba'i yul med par bsam/ de bzhin du bdag gi gnyen dang lha thams cad dpal ldan bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'dod chags zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba thams cad dpal ldan bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o/

/gti mug zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos po thams cad dpal ldan bla ma la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'dzin chags ser sna zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod cing / gong bzhin so so'i thad kyi dmigs pa rnams dran par bya/ de rjes bdag gi lus 'di la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsag par bya'o snyam pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pas bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ rang gi mdun du mi mgo skam po'i sgyed bu blos 'khyud tshad gsum bsgom/ rang gi lag pa g.yas su gang nas byung cha med par ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa gcig byung bar bsam/ des rang gi smin mtshams nas ltag pa'i bdud sgo'i bar gyi thod pa ling gis phog la/ mdun gyi sgyed bu'i steng du bzhag pas thod pa de nyid yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig tu bsam/ de nas rang gi lag pa g.yon pa g.yas kyi ral gris dum bu gsum du bcad la thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon pa rkang pa g.yas pa rnams bskyur/ khog pa kha phye la rgyu lto la sogs pa'i nang khrol/ mkhal ma/ mtsher ba/ mchin pa/ lus kyi khog pa'i smad kyi cha/ rked pa'i cha/ stod kyi cha rnams dum bur btub la bskyur/ mthar lag pa g.yas ral gri dang bcas pa'ang bskyur bas/ rnam smin sha khrag gi lus ni med/ rang sems de nyid skad cig gis nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba ltar/ gshin rje gshed kyi skur gyur par bsam/ des thod pa'i nang gi sha rus sogs la dmigs te/ ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod pas thod pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam par bsam/ de nyid las thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba rim bzhin 'chad de thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma gshin rje gshed kyi rnam pa la lan gsum phul bar bsam/

'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas ljags rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bas/ sku lus nyams dang ldan thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas tshims nas/ bdag la spros med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub da lta nyid du stsol bar bsam/ de bzhin du rim bzhin bsams la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la dmigs te 'bru gsum lan gcig yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ sangs rgyas sprul sku nyan rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa la/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs las bzhi sgrub byed kyi lha rnams la phul bar bsams nas 'bru gsum tshar re re brjod/ mthar 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re phul bas/ so so'i sdug bsngal dang bral zhing gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam/ khyad par du yang / rang nyid la tshe rabs thog med nas lan chags sha 'khon yod pa'i dgra 'dre/ tshe 'dir bsam sbyor ngan pas byad kha rbod gtong byed pa'i byad ma lha dang bcas pa la dmigs te 'bru gsum brjod cing byin pas/ rang gang 'dod kyi mkho dgur gyur pa la longs spyad pas/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub sdig sgrib thams cad dbyings su dag nas sangs rgyas thob par bsams pa ni spros pa bcad pa'o/ /gnyis pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas nas phyogs bcu'i zhing du gshegs/ mdun gyi thod pa sogs nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ las bzhi sgrub byed kyi lha rnams sangs rgyas sprul sku 'khor bcas la thim/ de rnams yi dam la/ de rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum dbyer mi phyed par bsams la/ mos gus kyi gdung shugs drag pos sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/

sems chos kyi skur gyur par bsam/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas bla ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du gyur/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du gyur/ sangs thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus sprul pa'i skur gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi chos nyid de bzhin ro gcig tu gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsum ye shes lnga yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bdag gi phung khams skye mched thams cad ngo bo nyid kyi sku yon tan 'phrin las kyi 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur par bsams pa ni byin gyis brlab pa'o/ gsum pa de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa ni/ ngag tu/ 'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa dang / /rig pa de nyid ma 'gag pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /'di nyid gsal zhing stong pa nyid/ /'di las mtshon te shes par bya/ /'di yi rang bzhin sku gsum dang / /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed ma yin/ /zhes brjod/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas mig mi 'dzum par smin mtshams kyi thad ka'i bar snang stong pa la had de blta/ ngag dbugs rgyu ba rang sor bzhag sems bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dang / rang rig pa dbyer med de nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar rang yal du song nas/

stong pa'i ye shes tsam du'ang 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la ma bcos par lus sems lhod kyis glod la bzhag de'i tshe rtog pa bun gyis skyes na/ de nyid ngos zin par byas la ched du spong sgrub gang yang mi byed par/ ngo bo la cher gyis bltas pas/ dang po gang nas byung med/ mthar gang du 'gro med/ da lta dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa gang du'ang ma grub pa/ rnam rtog gis ma bslad cing / gnyen pos ma bcos pa'i gshis 'dzin med gsal zhing stong pa thal le ba'i ngang du ci gnas bzhag thun mtshams su/ chos sku stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ /'gro la snying rje rgyun mi chad/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa mtha' yas pas/ /yul dang dngos po byed pa po/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin med pas/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad/ /ces brjod cing de'i don de ltar spros med ma rtogs pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' khyab kyi sems can la snying rje tshad med pa bsgom zhing / bdag gzhan snod bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du shes par byas la/ dge ba'i bya ba la brtson par bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jam dbyangs ye shes 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pas dge ba bsngo zhing / spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs kyang 'dir bya'o/ /kwa ye grogs dag dben pa'i ri sul du/ /dgos med tshe 'di'i bya ba kun dor nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs zab spros med la/ /rtse gcig mnyam par 'jog pa mi rigs sam/ /de skad smras 'di rje btsun dhū ti pa'i/ /gsung las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor blo gsal gyis/ /shangs lung rin chen sgang gi dgon pa ru/ /sbyar ba'i dge bas phan bde kun 'byung shog /shu bhaṃ mastu sarbā dza gat+taṃ/ rje btsun bla ma de nyid kyi sku drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba'i btsun pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bgyis pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
